entities.name: Brin
entities.description: A young bonder with an earnest love for monsters, bonded to Roland, who becomes a moral compass among the bonders.

entities.name: Roland
entities.description: Brin's massive, pink-furred raccoon-like monster bondmate who communicates through chirps.

entities.name: Lukka
entities.description: A bonder in a Drannith uniform who gains control of the monsters through the Ozolith and besieges Drannith.

entities.name: Vivien Reid
entities.description: A planeswalker who reveals another planeswalker tampered with the Ozolith and helps defend Drannith.

entities.name: Abda
entities.description: A bonder who saves Brin and is killed by a bolt from the skyship Vermilion.

entities.name: Barrow
entities.description: A bonder who broadcasts a magical call that draws bonders to Drannith.

entities.name: Zeph
entities.description: Barrow's monster bondmate, whom Brin rides.

entities.name: Jirina
entities.description: A leader of Drannith's defense who brings her monster allies into the city.

entities.name: Colonel Bryd
entities.description: A Drannith officer relieved of command at the main gate.

entities.name: Vheen
entities.description: A bonder who heard Barrow's call and came to Drannith.

entities.name: Leori
entities.description: A flying winged cat monster the group rides to the Ozolith.

entities.name: Ozolith
entities.description: A crystal structure affecting monster behavior that granted Lukka control over the monsters.

entities.name: Drannith
entities.description: A walled city besieged by Lukka's army of monsters.

entities.name: Ikoria
entities.description: The monster-filled plane where the story takes place.

entities.name: Siege of Drannith
entities.description: Lukka's assault on Drannith with a vast monster army.

entities.name: Battle at the Ozolith
entities.description: The clash between bonders, hunters and the crystal's guardian nightmares.

events.summary: Brin and Roland meet Lukka and Vivien at a crystal formation on the Egali plains and agree to help reach the Ozolith.
events.quote: When Vivien and Lukka proposed joining forces to reach the Ozolith, Brin agreed to help

events.summary: Brin gathers bonded pairs, including Abda and Rigi and Barrow and Zeph, to coordinate a response to the disturbance in monsters.
events.quote: Brin's primary concern remained the safety of monsters

events.summary: Nightmare creatures surge from the crystal field and the Battle at the Ozolith begins.
events.quote: The Battle at the Ozolith started when the nightmare creatures surged from the crystal field.

events.summary: Abda saves Brin but is killed by a bolt from the skyship Vermilion; the nightmares then overwhelm the hunters.
events.quote: A bolt from the skyship Vermilion struck Abda, killing her instantly.

events.summary: Lukka emerges altered, claiming the Ozolith has granted him control over the monsters to serve Drannith with a monstrous army.
events.quote: Brin listened as he explained that the Ozolith had granted him control over the monsters.

events.summary: Lukka tries to command Roland through the Ozolith; Vivien attacks him, letting Brin and the bonders flee.
events.quote: Vivien intervened by attacking Lukka, allowing Brin to flee.

events.summary: Brin and Roland enter Drannith with Jirina's group after Colonel Bryd is relieved of command.
events.quote: Once Bryd was relieved of command, Brin and Roland were accepted into the city

events.summary: The defenders plan Drannith's defense in the Citadel war room, and Brin reports that other bonders are on their way.
events.quote: She announced that Vheen and other bonders had heard Barrow's magical broadcast and were on their way.

events.summary: The Siege of Drannith begins at sunrise as Lukka's army appears.
events.quote: as the Siege of Drannith started.

events.summary: Monsters breach the inner city and Brin relays Barrow's warnings to Jirina.
events.quote: some flyers and burrowers had bypassed the walls and were attacking civilians

events.summary: Vivien's summoned monstrosaur turns the battle and the bonders encircle Lukka, ending the assault.
events.quote: the bonders encircled Lukka and brought the assault to a close.

events.summary: Brin and Roland settle in the First Ring, symbolizing the alliance of humans and monsters.
events.quote: Brin and Roland were among the bonders permitted to settle in the First Ring of Drannith after the city's defense.
